name: Beef Chuck
siboNotes: Plain beef chuck is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated. Avoid marinades or seasonings containing garlic, onion, or high FODMAP ingredients.
preparationTips: Season with garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Use FODMAP-friendly herbs like rosemary, thyme, or oregano
Slow cooking makes this tough cut tender and digestible
Remove visible fat if experiencing digestive sensitivity
